board_states.description: A slide presents Question 1 about whether the unit step function is absolutely integrable over the whole real line. It lists five multiple-choice answers, with large hand-drawn circles and other annotations over the slide.
board_states.text:
Question 1
Is the unit step function 1(t) absolutely integrable over the interval (−∞,∞)?
Potential answers:
I: Yes, because it is bounded.
II: No, because its integral over (−∞,∞) diverges.
III: Yes, because it is zero for t ≤ 0.
IV: No, because it is discontinuous at t = 0.
V: I do not know.
